firstSentence: Deploy 100B-parameter multimodal fraud detection agent swarms for payment gateways, analyzing transaction risk graphs in sub-8ms to block distributed carding attacks.
heroImageAlt: 100B-Parameter Autonomous Fraud Detection Agent Swarms for Payment Gateways
paragraphs: Tier-1 payment gateways and merchant acquirers process thousands of financial transactions every second, leaving less than a 10-millisecond window to identify and block sophisticated distributed fraud attacks. Traditional rule-based fraud filters and shallow machine learning models fail to detect organized carding botnets, BIN attack waves, and coordinated merchant identity theft across distributed merchant accounts. False positives disrupt legitimate shoppers, causing catastrophic merchant revenue loss.

Our sovereign fraud detection architecture deploys a 100B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agent swarm across dedicated NVIDIA H100 SXM5 GPU clusters in private banking VPCs. Ingress payment authorization payloads enter through zero-copy shared memory queues via mutual TLS. The swarm executes specialized expert models in parallel: behavioral velocity analysis, device fingerprint graph embedding, biometric typing rhythm evaluation, and historical cardholder risk scoring.

The fraud detection state machine calculates a unified composite risk score in under 7.8 milliseconds. It updates real-time transaction graph nodes across millions of concurrent payment streams, identifying coordinated botnet IP clusters and stolen credential reuse across disparate merchants. Transactions exceeding risk thresholds trigger automated challenge workflows (such as step-up biometric authentication) or instant zero-latency transaction rejection.

Compliance strictly adheres to RBI Master Directions on Card Payment Security, PCI-DSS Level 1 mandates, and Section 8(5) of the DPDP Act 2023. The cluster processes 4,100 authorization evaluations per second per node with a 99.94% fraud detection rate, reducing false positive rejections by 78% and protecting billions in daily transaction volume.

faqs.question: How can a 100B-parameter model execute within an 8ms payment gateway authorization window?
faqs.answer: By leveraging 8-bit floating-point (FP8) Tensor Core quantization, TensorRT-LLM optimized kernels, and sparse Mixture-of-Experts routing, only relevant parameter subsets are activated per transaction.

faqs.question: Does the fraud detection swarm support non-card payments like UPI and NetBanking?
faqs.answer: Yes. The architecture includes dedicated expert models trained on UPI handle velocity, beneficiary VPA risk graphs, and NetBanking session telemetry.

faqs.question: How does the system ensure PCI-DSS compliance when analyzing cardholder data?
faqs.answer: The entire inference engine executes inside a hardware-isolated enclave where Primary Account Numbers (PAN) are tokenized in volatile memory with zero persistent storage logging.
